source: MountTypes from the live game's Game.swz, drawing rules from its Login.swz EntTypes

mounts.name: Buckskin Horse
mounts.description: The Buckskin Pony regards you patiently. He knows the trail, won't wear down, and never misses his chance to eat.

mounts.name: Destrier
mounts.description: Proud bearing, immaculate coat, rich barding. The Destrier is a steed for kings and kings at heart.

mounts.name: Black Stallion
mounts.description: Faded battle scars criss-cross the stallion's black coat. This is a sturdy companion in your fight.

mounts.name: Light Horse
mounts.description: She's a regal horse and a trusty steed. A natural unicorn? Only her groomer knows for sure.

mounts.name: White Mare
mounts.description: The Mare stamps with impatience. Her restlessness says "Adventure awaits. Why are we still standing here?"

mounts.name: Kirin
mounts.description: This elegant creature roams the plain lands and has become very popular and domesticated.

mounts.name: Mojack
mounts.description: This best-in-show breed is stalwart and wise. Due to its rarity if you have mo money you can get Mojack.

mounts.name: Red Water Drakken
mounts.description: A cautionary tale for those brave enough to ride this beast; treat it well or red is the last color you will ever see.

mounts.name: The Nightmare
mounts.description: Legend has it that these entities guard the realm of the Shadowlands. Once a year when the moons align they can be spotted in the darkest of corners.

mounts.name: Short Coat Wolfbear
mounts.description: A Creature that is part wolf, part bear, all Wolfbear.

mounts.name: Arctic Megalynx
mounts.description: Not quite man's best friend, but if well fed the Megalynx purr heavily.

mounts.name: Brimstone Fangrasaur
mounts.description: The smell of sulfur and ash hang heavy around this brooding monster. The Fangrasaur eyes you warily.

mounts.name: Snarglak
mounts.description: You can see this beast was once ridden by Desert Orcs. How it came to this land is anyone's guess.

mounts.name: Albino Wolfhare
mounts.description: Remarkably, this beast lays eggs. You should under no circumstance attempt to dye them.

mounts.name: Ancient Crypt Walker
mounts.description: Little is known about these re-animated constructs. Mysteriously, they pierce the veil with a cold lifeless stare.

mounts.name: Moongaze Megalynx
mounts.description: Its eyes catch the moon like coins at the bottom of a well. It blinks first, always.

mounts.name: Snowmelt Megalynx
mounts.description: It naps on sun-warmed ledges and goes everywhere at the exact speed of melting ice.

mounts.name: Nightgnaw Snarglak
mounts.description: Something in the dark has been chewing on the fence. The Snarglak looks innocent. The fence disagrees.

mounts.name: Sunburrow Snarglak
mounts.description: It digs to the warm side of every hill and defends the hole like it planned the sunshine.

mounts.name: Duskthump Wolfhare
mounts.description: It thumps once at dusk and every burrow within a mile goes quiet with it.

mounts.name: Sunpatch Wolfhare
mounts.description: It claims the warmest rock at dawn and defends it from everything smaller, which is everything.

mounts.name: Tollgate Crypthound
mounts.description: It sits by crypt doors at night, and the bells toll once when it is satisfied with you.

mounts.name: Glassbell Crypthound
mounts.description: Its mask rings like struck glass at first light, and the crypt lets it out for the day.

mounts.name: Cinderscale Fangrasaur
mounts.description: Its scales shed a fine gray ash that gets into everything and ruins exactly one pair of boots per rider.

mounts.name: Flarecrest Fangrasaur
mounts.description: The crest flares bright when the sun hits it, which is either a display or a challenge.

mounts.name: Lastlight Walker
mounts.description: It walks the dark aisles when the candles gutter, keeping a vigil no one asked it to keep.

mounts.name: Morningrite Walker
mounts.description: It meets the sunrise standing perfectly still, and whatever it is waiting for has not come yet.

mounts.name: Nighthowl Wolfbear
mounts.description: The winter howl comes out around dusk and carries over two ridges. Three if the wind helps.

mounts.name: Springhowl Wolfbear
mounts.description: It sheds the winter coat in one dramatic afternoon and howls about it until dinner.

mounts.name: Snapjaw Saurian
mounts.description: The jaw is the whole argument. Everything else about the Snapjaw is just transportation for it.

mounts.name: Mirejaw Saurian
mounts.description: It breeds in the fog bottoms where the swamp swallows sound, and its snap is usually the last thing you hear.

mounts.name: Goldmaw Saurian
mounts.description: Its scales bake to a brass shine by midmorning, and the jaw has bitten through a castle gate. Once.

mounts.name: Emberback Boar
mounts.description: Ember-red bristles run down its spine like a lit fuse. The charge is only the beginning of the trouble.

mounts.name: Cinderbristle Boar
mounts.description: Its bristles smolder all night, which is why boar riders never worry about the dark -- or the dry grass.

mounts.name: Giltbristle Boar
mounts.description: Morning sun turns its bristles to gold wire. Its temper does not improve with the lighting.

mounts.name: Thunderhorn Rhino
mounts.description: When the Thunderhorn lowers its horn, the ground hums. When it charges, the ground gives up.

mounts.name: Stormhide Rhino
mounts.description: Thunder has chased this one since it was a calf, and it has learned to give the thunder back.

mounts.name: Dawnbreaker Rhino
mounts.description: It charges the rising sun out of habit and arrives somewhere else entirely by breakfast.

mounts.name: Snapshell Turtle
mounts.description: Its shell latches shut with a crack like a portcullis, and it takes a siege to open it again.

mounts.name: Gloomshell Turtle
mounts.description: Algae paints its shell pond-dark, and whole ambushes have been planned on its back.

mounts.name: Gildeshell Turtle
mounts.description: Its shell polishes to a mirror shine, and it has been mistaken for treasure. It objects to being looted.

mounts.name: Ridgefang Tiger
mounts.description: It stalks the high ridges in silence and pounces before the mountain knows anything is missing.

mounts.name: Nightprowl Tiger
mounts.description: It hunts by starlight and has never once been seen arriving.

mounts.name: Daymark Tiger
mounts.description: It walks the high ridgeline at noon, perfectly aware that everything below can see it.

mounts.name: Glaciermaw Polar Bear
mounts.description: It naps in snowdrifts and wakes hungry. Riders learn to keep snacks in easy reach, or become them.

mounts.name: Hoarfrost Bear
mounts.description: Its breath freezes midair and falls around it like snow. It finds this hilarious.

mounts.name: Sunveil Bear
mounts.description: It sleeps through the bright hours draped in a snow-white pelt and wakes when the shadows go long.

mounts.name: Tuskcharge Tusker
mounts.description: Two tusks, one opinion, and no interest in hearing yours. Hold on through the first turn.

mounts.name: Duskfall Tusker
mounts.description: It waits until the light goes bad, then goes. The fence was never really a factor.

mounts.name: Daybreak Tusker
mounts.description: It greets sunrise by charging it. The sunrise always wins, but the fence does not.

mounts.name: Dewback Lizard
mounts.description: It drinks a pond dry at a gulp and carries water in the folds of its neck for the long desert road.

mounts.name: Mirageback Lizard
mounts.description: Riders swear it was not there a moment ago. The lizard agrees and keeps walking.

mounts.name: Sunstride Lizard
mounts.description: It paces caravans across the flats at a lazy trot, arriving before the water runs out.

mounts.name: Baku
mounts.description: Feed it pleasant dreams and it will carry you gently. Feed it nightmares at your own peril.

mounts.name: Moonhollow Baku
mounts.description: It feeds on dreams by moonlight and leaves the sleeper with nothing but a good mood.

mounts.name: Daydream Baku
mounts.description: The only baku that snacks while you are awake. You lose a little of the afternoon and do not mind.

mounts.name: Fanged Dragon
mounts.description: Every tooth in its grin is its own diplomatic incident. Ride with your hands to yourself.

mounts.name: Gloamfang Dragon
mounts.description: Its teeth glow faintly after dark, which has ruined more ambushes than it has made.

mounts.name: Sunfang Dragon
mounts.description: It suns itself on warm stone with its fangs showing. This is not a warning. Usually.

mounts.name: Equine Drake
mounts.description: The stablemaster swears it is a horse. The tail, wings, and appetite for charcoal suggest otherwise.

mounts.name: Nightmane Drake
mounts.description: The mane drinks in lantern light, and the hooves, worryingly, do not make much sound.

mounts.name: Dawnmane Drake
mounts.description: Its mane catches sunrise like banners. The stablemaster has stopped insisting it is a horse.

mounts.name: Haku Dragon
mounts.description: White as first frost and quiet as falling snow, the Haku glides more than it flies.

mounts.name: Frost Haku Dragon
mounts.description: Winter clouds follow it politely, and the snow it sheds never seems to land.

mounts.name: Aurora Haku Dragon
mounts.description: It flies the high night ice where the lights live, and comes down glowing faintly green.

mounts.name: Duskguard Destrier
mounts.description: It stands its watch without being asked and disapproves of surprises on principle.

mounts.name: Sunward Destrier
mounts.description: It holds the vanguard at first light, mane braided, utterly certain of the plan.

mounts.name: Nightcart Horse
mounts.description: It knows the late delivery routes better than the drivers do and refuses to hurry for anyone.

mounts.name: Sunharvest Horse
mounts.description: It works the bright fields all day and pulls harder when someone is watching. Someone is always watching.

mounts.name: Tidewrack Drakken
mounts.description: It surfs the evening tide for the joy of it and comes ashore salt-crusted and smug.

mounts.name: Mistral Drakken
mounts.description: It rides the morning wind off the water, wings barely moving, smelling faintly of rain.

mounts.name: Moonveil Kirin
mounts.description: It steps between moonbeams without bending them, and the forest pretends not to notice.

mounts.name: Sunpearl Kirin
mounts.description: Its scales hold the morning like pearls hold the sky, one small weather at a time.

mounts.name: Duskrider Horse
mounts.description: It was bred for scouting the treeline at half-light, and it still prefers the edges of things.

mounts.name: Meridian Horse
mounts.description: It travels fastest at the brightest hour and treats clouds as a personal insult.

mounts.name: Moonscale Longma
mounts.description: Its scales are said to be cut from the river's reflection of the moon. The river disagrees.

mounts.name: Sungilt Longma
mounts.description: It appears at the head of sunrise processions, whether invited or not.

mounts.name: Moonglade Mare
mounts.description: It is easiest to spot at night, being the brightest thing in the field after the moon.

mounts.name: Goldleaf Mare
mounts.description: By day its white coat takes a warm gold sheen, and foals follow it around the pasture.

mounts.name: Nightloader Mojack
mounts.description: It hauls camp gear in the dark and has strong opinions about where the tent goes.

mounts.name: Morningpack Mojack
mounts.description: It is loaded at first light and has never once been the reason a caravan left late.

mounts.name: Duskfire Nightmare
mounts.description: Its mane burns low and blue after dark, and riders report excellent dreams. Mostly.

mounts.name: Sunfire Nightmare
mounts.description: By day its flame runs bright gold, and it is -- technically, legally -- a different horse.

mounts.name: Midnight Stallion
mounts.description: Bred from a line that only ever seemed to be exercised after curfew.

mounts.name: Embercoat Stallion
mounts.description: At dawn the black coat throws off red highlights like banked coals waking up.

mounts.name: Emberwing Dragon
mounts.description: An even-tempered war dragon that folds its wings neatly and pretends not to notice the stable cat.

mounts.name: Cindermaw Dragon
mounts.description: It exhales sparks that glow like dying coals and prefers to hunt long after the campfire has gone out.

mounts.name: Dawnspire Dragon
mounts.description: First light catches its crest like a torch being lit, and it considers sunrise a personal fanfare.

mounts.name: Sabertooth Dragon
mounts.description: Named for the sabers in its smile. It uses them for opening coconuts, mostly on purpose.

mounts.name: Nightbite Dragon
mounts.description: It hunts after lights-out with a mouth full of very patient knives.

mounts.name: Goldfang Dragon
mounts.description: Its fangs stain gold from the sap of the fruit it steals at midday. It is not sorry.

mounts.name: Classic Dragon
mounts.description: The dragon every story starts with: green of scale, steady of wing, and politely hungry.

mounts.name: Shadewing Dragon
mounts.description: The storybook dragon, after the story moves past bedtime: same green, considerably more teeth.

mounts.name: Heraldry Dragon
mounts.description: It perches on towers at high noon, perfectly composed, as if painted there on purpose.

mounts.name: Ironscale War Dragon
mounts.description: Barded in overlapping iron scales, it has forgotten what it feels like to be scratched behind the horn.

mounts.name: Blackplate War Dragon
mounts.description: Its barding drinks the light; on night maneuvers, only the rider's lantern gives it away.

mounts.name: Paradeplate War Dragon
mounts.description: Its ceremonial armor blinds the honor guard at morning review, which it considers a tactical advantage.

mounts.name: Gravefeeder Dragon
mounts.description: It grazes where it pleases and does not strictly require you to still be alive to be carried.

mounts.name: Mistmourn Dragon
mounts.description: It grazes the fog bottoms of old battlefields, humming to the bones it finds.

mounts.name: Dawnrisen Dragon
mounts.description: The grave dirt steams off its back at sunrise, and the smell has ended negotiations early.

mounts.name: Smaug Dragon
mounts.description: It hoards shiny things and grudges in equal measure, and has never once confused the two.

mounts.name: Nightvault Dragon
mounts.description: It sleeps on the hoard with one eye open, which is worse than both, somehow.

mounts.name: Gildedhoard Dragon
mounts.description: By daylight the hoard glitters and so does the dragon, in about equal measure.

mounts.name: Ivorystorm Guardian
mounts.description: Born of holy ritual, these creatures are said to have fallen from the heavens of the ancient gods.

mounts.name: Hatebreed Charger
mounts.description: These baneful creatures stampede the land between the living and the dead, feasting on wandering souls.

mounts.name: Stormhoof Stallion
mounts.description: These elven-trained warhorses can gallop faster than an Eastern wind and are just as temperamental.
